notes.title: Tank Core Demo Major Update - Demo Version 0.3 Patch Notes:
notes.notes: [h3]1.Player[/h3][p][/p][p]5 new turrets[/p][p]5 new chassis[/p][p]6 new shells[/p][p]6 new modules[/p][p]43 new cores[/p][p]Adjusted many old components[/p][p]Added an prop system with 5 basic props. Basic prop will spawn periodically during levels[/p][p]Merged Level 1 & 2 turrets and chassis to strengthen early-game power[/p][p]Shell slots are fixed at 2, toggled back and forth[/p][p][/p][h3]2.Enemy[/h3][p][/p][p]14 new enemies[/p][p]3 new enemy supports[/p][p]Adjusted some old enemies, mainly weakens enemies[/p][p][/p][h3]3.Level[/h3][p][/p][p]9 new terrains[/p][p]1 new area[/p][p]40+ new level[/p][p]Adjusted many old levels[/p][p]Levels no longer end immediately upon timeout, enemy bombers will spawn and attack[/p][p]Added defense level, Survive until the timer runs out to win[/p][p]Adjusted pass level reward[/p][p]Store sells more things[/p][p][/p][h3]4.Others[/h3][p][/p][p]Adjusted many UIs, primarily on both sides of the levels, the refit factory UI, and the store UI[/p][p]The level editor shows the map dimensions (width/height) and supports dynamic resizing[/p][p]When viewing components, cleared turrets and chassis are marked with medal icons[/p][p]Etc.[/p]
